content.title: Cenovus CEO defends MEG Energy bid, which is 'fair and final'
content.summary: The CEO of Canada's Cenovus Energy  pushed back on Friday against criticisms of his company's bid for rival oil sands producer MEG Energy, telling Reuters the offer is fair and final.  Jon McKenzie made the comments a day after Cenovus issued a slide deck advocating for its cash-and-stock offer for the company.  Cenovus' offer, made in August, would combine MEG's Christina Lake operations with Cenovus' adjacent assets, creating one of Canada's largest oil sands companies producing more than 720,000 barrels per day.
